# Objectives

To assess BLM's assumption of humic acid content (HA) of dissolved organic carbon (DOC), we will assess bioavailability across a range of HA % 10-60 by increments of 10.

# 1. Setup

Set working directory

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt/Copper/7. Sensitivity analyses")
```

Import the dataset with BLM results under varying HA (%) and the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet 3 which contains Typologies

```{r}
library(readxl)

ha_dat <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt/Copper/3. Dataset cleaning/Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean.xlsx", 
    sheet = "HA 10-60%")

head(ha_dat)

bms <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/BLM_spatial_assessmt/Copper/5. Cluster analysis/Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet_Clean3.xlsx")

head(bms)
```

Add Typology column from bms to ha_dat to sample IDs retained in bms

```{r}
library(dplyr)

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Check whether both datasets contain the same Sample_ID values
#------------------------------------------------------------

# Unique Sample_IDs in each dataset
ha_ids  <- ha_dat %>% distinct(Sample_ID)
bms_ids <- bms %>% distinct(Sample_ID)

# Sample_IDs in ha_dat but not in bms
ha_not_in_bms <- ha_ids %>%
  anti_join(bms_ids, by = "Sample_ID")

# Sample_IDs in bms but not in ha_dat
bms_not_in_ha <- bms_ids %>%
  anti_join(ha_ids, by = "Sample_ID")

# Sample_IDs in ha_dat not in bms, likely filtered out
nrow(ha_not_in_bms)
ha_not_in_bms

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Omit samples in ha_dat that do not appear in bms
#------------------------------------------------------------
ha_dat <- ha_dat %>%
  semi_join(bms %>% distinct(Sample_ID), by = "Sample_ID")

#------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Add Typology from bms to ha_dat by Sample_ID
#------------------------------------------------------------
ha_dat <- ha_dat %>%
  left_join(
    bms %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Typology) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  )

# View result
str(ha_dat)
head(ha_dat)
```

# 2. Sensitivity Analysis

Computed differences in TBL-Cu (nmol/g) within each Sample_ID for each incremental increase in HA (%). To do so, first create ha_sens

```{r}
library(dplyr)

ha_sens <- ha_dat %>%
  arrange(Sample_ID, HA_content) %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID, Typology) %>%
  
  # Create "next HA" value within each sample
  mutate(
    HA_next = lead(HA_content),
    TBL_next = lead(TBL_Cu_nmol_g)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only valid transitions (drop last HA=60 rows)
  filter(!is.na(HA_next)) %>%
  
  # Optional: ensure only 10-step increments
  filter(HA_next - HA_content == 10)

# Preview
head(ha_sens)
```

## i. Calculate metrics

-   **Delta:** absolute change

-   **Percent change:** relative change

-   **Log response ratio (LRR):** log10(next / current)

```{r}
ha_sens <- ha_sens %>%
  mutate(
    delta = TBL_next - TBL_Cu_nmol_g,
    
    pct_change = (TBL_next - TBL_Cu_nmol_g) / TBL_Cu_nmol_g * 100,
    
    log_rr = log10(TBL_next / TBL_Cu_nmol_g),
    
    HA_transition = paste0(HA_content, "-", HA_next)
  )

# Preview
head(ha_sens)
```

## ii. Summary statistics

Mean and SE of each SA metric by typology by incremental increase in HA (%)

```{r}
ha_summary <- ha_sens %>%
  group_by(Typology, HA_transition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_delta   = sd(delta, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    mean_pct_change = mean(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_pct_change   = sd(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    mean_log_rr = mean(log_rr, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_log_rr   = sd(log_rr, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

View(ha_summary)

# Save
library(openxlsx)

# Define output directory
out_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Plots of HA SA")

# Create it only if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir)
}

# Create workbook
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Add worksheet
addWorksheet(wb, "HA_Sensitivity_Summary")

# Write data
writeData(wb, "HA_Sensitivity_Summary", ha_summary)

# Save file
saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "HA_Sensitivity_Summary.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

Summary across all HA (%) increases

```{r}
ha_summary_overall <- ha_sens %>%
  group_by(Typology) %>%
  summarise(

    se_pct_change   = sd(pct_change, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    mean_log_rr = mean(log_rr, na.rm = TRUE),

View(ha_summary_overall)
```

# 3. Difference in bioavailability at 10 and 60% HA by Typology

Paired t-test and Wilcox signed-rank test (parametric and non-parametric). If both are significant = robust difference.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare paired dataset (10% vs 60%)
#-------------------------------------------------
ha_ttest_dat <- ha_dat %>%
  filter(HA_content %in% c(10, 60)) %>%
  mutate(log_tbl_cu = log10(TBL_Cu_nmol_g)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Typology, HA_content, log_tbl_cu) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = HA_content,
    values_from = log_tbl_cu,
    names_prefix = "HA_"
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only complete pairs
  filter(!is.na(HA_10), !is.na(HA_60))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2. Run paired t-test by Typology
#-------------------------------------------------
ttest_results <- ha_ttest_dat %>%
  group_by(Typology) %>%
  summarise(
    # Paired t-test
    t_test = list(t.test(HA_10, HA_60, paired = TRUE)),
    
    # Wilcoxon paired test
    wilcox_test = list(wilcox.test(HA_10, HA_60, paired = TRUE)),
    
    mean_10 = mean(HA_10, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_60 = mean(HA_60, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    t_stat      = map_dbl(t_test, ~ .x$statistic),
    t_p_value   = map_dbl(t_test, ~ .x$p.value),
    
    w_stat      = map_dbl(wilcox_test, ~ .x$statistic),
    w_p_value   = map_dbl(wilcox_test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(
    Typology,
    mean_10,
    mean_60,
    t_stat,
    t_p_value,
    w_stat,
    w_p_value
  )

# Save
library(openxlsx)
write.xlsx(
  x = ttest_results,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "HA10-60_t-test.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

# 4. Differences in Bioavailability by Typology at 60% HA

Kruskal Wallis test

```{r}
# Isolate data for HA 60%
ha_60 <- ha_dat %>%
  filter(HA_content == 60) %>%
  mutate(log_tbl_cu = log10(TBL_Cu_nmol_g)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Typology), !is.na(log_tbl_cu))

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(log_tbl_cu ~ Typology, data = ha_60)

kruskal_res
```

Post hoc comparisonsPost hoc comparisons

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(agricolae)

alpha <- 0.05

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare HA = 60% data
#-------------------------------------------------
ha_60 <- ha_dat %>%
  filter(HA_content == 60) %>%
  mutate(
    log_tbl_cu = log10(TBL_Cu_nmol_g),
    Typology = factor(Typology)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Typology), !is.na(log_tbl_cu))

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2. Kruskal-Wallis test
#-------------------------------------------------
kw_test <- kruskal.test(log_tbl_cu ~ Typology, data = ha_60)

kw_test

#-------------------------------------------------
# 3. Agricolae Kruskal post-hoc letter groups
#-------------------------------------------------
k_out <- agricolae::kruskal(
  y     = ha_60$log_tbl_cu,
  trt   = ha_60$Typology,
  alpha = alpha,
  group = TRUE
)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract grouping letters
#-------------------------------------------------
letters_df <- k_out$groups %>%
  rownames_to_column("Typology") %>%
  rename(Letters = groups)

#-------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combined results table
#-------------------------------------------------
kw_letters_results <- letters_df %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = "log10_TBL_Cu_HA60",
    Chi_sq = as.numeric(kw_test$statistic),
    df = as.numeric(kw_test$parameter),
    p_value = as.numeric(kw_test$p.value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Typology, Letters, Chi_sq, df, p_value)

kw_letters_results

#-------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save
#-------------------------------------------------
library(openxlsx)
file_path <- file.path(out_dir, "KW_test_HA60.xlsx")
write.xlsx(
  x = list(
    "KW_letters" = kw_letters_results,
    "KW_summary" = data.frame(
      test    = kw_test$method,
      variable = "log10_TBL_Cu_HA60",
      chi_sq  = as.numeric(kw_test$statistic),
      df      = as.numeric(kw_test$parameter),
      p_value = kw_test$p.value
    )
  ),
  file = file_path,
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

# 5. Plots by Typology

Quick re-assignment of letters by Typology at HA=10%

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(agricolae)

alpha <- 0.05

#-------------------------------------------------
# 1. Post hoc letters at HA = 10 and HA = 60 only
#-------------------------------------------------
ha_letters <- ha_dat %>%
  filter(HA_content %in% c(10, 60)) %>%
  mutate(
    log_tbl_cu = log10(TBL_Cu_nmol_g)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Typology), !is.na(log_tbl_cu)) %>%
  group_by(HA_content) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    
    k_out <- agricolae::kruskal(
      y     = .x$log_tbl_cu,
      trt   = .x$Typology,
      alpha = alpha,
      group = TRUE
    )
    
    k_out$groups %>%
      rownames_to_column("Typology") %>%
      rename(Letters = groups)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

#-------------------------------------------------
# 2. Letter positions
#-------------------------------------------------
letter_positions <- ha_dat %>%
  filter(HA_content %in% c(10, 60)) %>%
  mutate(log_tbl_cu = log10(TBL_Cu_nmol_g)) %>%
  group_by(HA_content, Typology) %>%
  summarise(
    y_pos = mean(log_tbl_cu, na.rm = TRUE) +
      sd(log_tbl_cu, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()) +
      0.05,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(ha_letters, by = c("HA_content", "Typology"))

# Letters positions
offset_map <- c(
  "Pooled" = 0,
  "Perennial" = 0,
  "Developed Perennial" = 0,
  "Non-Perennial" = 0,
  "Main Stem" = 0.02
)

letter_positions <- letter_positions %>%
  mutate(y_offset = offset_map[Typology])
```

Plot

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

typology_colors <- c(
  "Pooled"    = "yellow3",
  "Perennial" = "#56B4E9",
  "Developed Perennial" = "#D55E00",
  "Non-Perennial" = "#009E73",
  "Main Stem"       = "#999999"
)

# Set order of typologies
ha_dat <- ha_dat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Typology = factor(
      Typology,
      levels = names(typology_colors)
    )
  )

ha_typ <- ggplot(
  ha_dat,
  aes(
    x = HA_content,
    y = log10(TBL_Cu_nmol_g),
    color = Typology
  )
) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 2,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
  data = letter_positions,
  aes(
    x = HA_content,
    y = y_pos + y_offset,   # stagger vertically
    label = Letters
  ),
  position = position_nudge(x = -1.2),  # left shift only
  color = "black",
  show.legend = FALSE,
  size = 4,
  fontface = "bold"
) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = typology_colors) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Humic Acid Content (%)",
    y = expression(log[10]~"TBL-Cu (nmol "~g^{-1}*")"),
    color = "Stream Typology",
    title = "Cu Bioavailability with Increasing Humic Acid Content"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

# View
ha_typ

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Cu_by_humic_acid_by_typology.png"),
  plot = ha_typ,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
```
